gen-gf-saira-extra-condensed-bitter: Modern and tightly packed, Saira Extra Condensed stretches its lowercase tall with strokes that never vary. Bitter, a slab-serif body with big-eyed lowercase, feels sturdy and grounded beside it, like a workbench under a sleek machine.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-clash-grotesk: Wide-mouthed letters drawn with one fixed nib width give Shantell Sans a loose, marker-made look that's hard to mistake. Clash Grotesk, with zero stroke modulation, gives that play a straight-faced partner.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-alpino: Shantell Sans draws stems and arcs like bent dowels, wide-mouthed and fixed at a single nib width. Alpino sits tall and tightly spaced beneath, its short-looking ascenders and cozy, casual manner keeping things relaxed.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk reads lively and tall, its bowls left open on one side and its lowercase standing high against the capitals. Shantell Sans earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-hind: Expressive and loose, Shantell Sans keeps one fixed nib width, while Hind stays steady, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Shrink the heading and its wide mouths lose their charm.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-nunito: Distinctive and expressive, Shantell Sans holds its curves at full weight right through the shoulders. And Nunito's big round bowls and terminals held away from the stem supply the pair's friendliest quality.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Expressive and wide-mouthed, Shantell Sans draws every stroke with one fixed nib, built to be noticed. Pilcrow Rounded does the quieter work, its letters tightly packed, its lowercase tall and its curves left open.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-quicksand: Quicksand reads approachable, its tall bowls rounded like blown glass bulbs. Make Shantell Sans small and its wide, fixed-nib mouths get lost, while Quicksand's tall, bulb-like bowls hold up.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-actor: A single unvarying stroke weight and wide-mouthed curves give Shantell Sans a skimming ease, like a marker gliding across paper. Actor then keeps things clean and modern, its wide s curves barely curled.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-akatab: Shantell Sans holds a constant stroke weight with no sparkle, just wide-mouthed, marker-like confidence. Akatab cups its round letters rather than clenching them, so paragraphs of text would unfold approachably and without fuss.
